subject: Submission sprint & scorecard — prep and Friday call
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-04-18T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Submission sprint & scorecard — prep and Friday call

Team —

Quick reminder: our Q2 weekly submission sprint is live. Finance needs a completed scorecard + the updated stage/commit flags by end-of-day Friday so we can finalize the board report. Please prioritize the following: 

1) Update the submission-template.csv (attached) with every active opportunity: stage, Net ARR, close date, rep confidence (1–5), and whether it’s a commit.
2) Move any opportunities that meet commit criteria to COMMIT and add a 1–2 sentence rationale in the notes column.
3) If deals require procurement or credit approvals (Atlas Analytics, see below), flag them and drop the supporting docs in the Drive folder.
4) Hygiene: remove duplicates, close stalled opps, and ensure HS IDs are present.

Attachments: Q2-scorecard.xlsx (summary view), submission-template.csv (please fill).
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3Cscorecards (add files to the "SUBMISSIONS/2027-04-Week3" folder)
HubSpot reference: HS:389210

Friday call (30 min) to review commits and risks:
- When: Friday 2027-04-21, 11:00–11:30 PT
- Dial-in: Zoom link in calendar invite (I’ll send in a follow-up)
- Attendees: Sales reps + Revenue Ops + Finance (Vivek will join)
- Prep: Bring 1 slide per commit opportunity (current ask, blockers, next step)

If you think a deal should remain in pipeline but be marked at-risk instead of commit, annotate the notes column — we’ll triage during the call.

Thanks — aiming for a clean submission by EOD Friday.

— Jasmine
Jasmine Liu | Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-04-19T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Submission sprint & scorecard — prep and Friday call

Thanks, Jasmine — I’m on it. Quick flag on Atlas Analytics (DEAL-AX-1192): procurement wants a redlined SOW and a standard data-processing addendum before they’ll move from legal to PO. I attached the redline I received from their counsel; finance will need to confirm T&Cs before I set as COMMIT.

Attachment: Atlas-SOW-redlined.pdf (redline from Atlas counsel)

I’ll update the submission-template with current ARR and tentative close date, but won’t mark COMMIT until we have procurement + finance OK. Will bring this to the call.

— Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Mid-Market
Redwood Inference

- I cleaned up three duplicate opps that had been created by lead imports (HS IDs 41011/41012). I closed the older duplicates and left the most recent record active.
- Two opps look like commit candidates if legal confirms timelines: DEAL-AX-1192 (Atlas) and DEAL-OS-2034 (one of the EDU deals). I flagged both in the submission-template with notes.

Subject: Re: Submission sprint & scorecard — prep and Friday call (final reminder)

Folks —

Final nudge ahead of the 11:00 PT sync. Quick checklist for this morning: 
- Confirm submission-template.csv is uploaded to the Drive SUBMISSIONS/2027-04-Week3 folder.
- Slide(s) for any COMMIT opps are in PREP_SLIDES. Keep slides to one page: ask, blocker, next step, owner.
- If you are waiting on procurement (Atlas) or finance sign-off, put that in the notes column and add the doc to the folder. Ben — I saw your redline; thanks. Finance (Vivek), can you confirm whether the redline changes are acceptable or if you need escalation to legal?

Agenda for the 11:00 call:
1) Quick roll call and confirmation of submitted files (5m)
2) Commit review: each rep (2m per commit) — ask/blocker/next step (15m)
3) Risk queue / ask list for finance/legal follow-ups (8m)

If anything comes up between now and the call, drop a note in this thread or DM. We’ll capture outstanding items and a short action list after the meeting.

See you on the call.

— Jasmine
Jasmine Liu | Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
